task: Build a tiny task list with an empty state and add-task interaction

acceptanceCriteria.claim: The page heading 'Receipts Demo' is visible
On first load with no tasks, an empty state with the text 'No tasks yet' is visible
acceptanceCriteria.navigationHint: open the app root as a fresh visitor

acceptanceCriteria.claim: After typing a task and clicking Add, the task appears as an item in the list and the empty state is gone
acceptanceCriteria.navigationHint: type 'Buy milk' into the input and click the Add button

plan: Render a controlled task array. Show an empty-state block when length === 0, otherwise render <li> rows. Add on button click or Enter.
decisions: Kept everything in a single static HTML file with vanilla JS so the example has zero dependencies and the demo works out of the box
Showed a live task count in the subheading so at least one claim is provable from a single screenshot without interaction
rejectedAlternatives: A React app for the demo — would add a build step and dependencies, defeating the 'works out of the box' goal
Persisting tasks to localStorage — out of scope and would complicate the empty-state claim

promptLog.text: Build a tiny task list demo and leave receipts on it
Building a single-file task list with an empty state, then running visual QA against three observable claims.
